en: Ants are small insects. Like all insects, an ant has six legs.
Ants live together in a big group called a colony. Many ants live in a nest under the ground.
When an ant finds food, it leaves a smell on the path back to the nest. Other ants follow the smell trail to the food.
Ants are very strong for their size. Some ants can carry things heavier than their own bodies.
If a crumb is too big for one ant, many ants carry it together.
Next time you see a line of ants, watch them. Where do you think they are going?
id: Semut adalah serangga kecil. Seperti semua serangga, semut punya enam kaki.
Semut hidup bersama dalam kelompok besar yang disebut koloni. Banyak semut tinggal di sarang di bawah tanah.
Ketika seekor semut menemukan makanan, ia meninggalkan bau di jalan pulang ke sarang. Semut lain mengikuti jejak bau itu menuju makanan.
Semut sangat kuat untuk ukurannya. Beberapa semut bisa membawa benda yang lebih berat dari tubuhnya sendiri.
Jika remah makanan terlalu besar untuk satu semut, banyak semut mengangkatnya bersama.
Lain kali kamu melihat barisan semut, perhatikan mereka. Menurutmu mereka mau ke mana?

objectives.en: Reads a short nonfiction text and finds facts in it.
objectives.id: Membaca teks nonfiksi pendek dan menemukan fakta di dalamnya.

objectives.en: Explains how ants find food and share work.
objectives.id: Menjelaskan cara semut menemukan makanan dan berbagi tugas.

meaning.en: a small animal with six legs
a big group of ants that live together
meaning.id: kelompok besar semut yang hidup bersama

meaning.en: a path that others can follow

prompt.en: How many legs does an ant have?
prompt.id: Berapa kaki yang dimiliki semut?

prompt.en: A colony is…
prompt.id: Koloni adalah…

en: a big group of ants living together
id: kelompok besar semut yang hidup bersama

prompt.en: Which sentence tells how other ants find the food?
prompt.id: Kalimat mana yang menjelaskan cara semut lain menemukan makanan?

en: Other ants follow the smell trail to the food.
Many ants live in a nest under the ground.
id: Semut lain mengikuti jejak bau itu menuju makanan.
Banyak semut tinggal di sarang di bawah tanah.

prompt.en: Why do ants walk in a line?
prompt.id: Mengapa semut berjalan berbaris?

en: they are all following the same smell path
they are lining up for school
id: mereka semua mengikuti jejak bau yang sama

prompt.en: 3 ants carry a crumb. 2 more ants come to help. How many ants carry it now?
prompt.id: 3 semut mengangkat remah. 2 semut lagi datang membantu. Berapa semut yang mengangkatnya sekarang?

connection.en: Insects have six legs; ants live in colonies and communicate with smell.
connection.id: Serangga berkaki enam; semut hidup dalam koloni dan berkomunikasi dengan bau.

connection.en: Adding helpers: more ants join to carry a heavy load.
connection.id: Menambah penolong: makin banyak semut bergabung untuk mengangkat beban berat.

discussionPrompts.en: What jobs do people in your family do together?
discussionPrompts.id: Pekerjaan apa yang dilakukan keluargamu bersama-sama?

discussionPrompts.en: Why is it helpful to work as a team?
discussionPrompts.id: Mengapa bekerja sebagai tim itu membantu?

offlineActivity.en: Put a tiny crumb of bread outside, away from the house. Check after 10 minutes and draw what the ants do. Watch only; do not touch the ants.
offlineActivity.id: Letakkan remah roti kecil di luar, jauh dari rumah. Periksa setelah 10 menit dan gambar apa yang dilakukan semut. Cukup amati; jangan sentuh semutnya.

factChecks.claim: Ants leave scent trails that other ants follow to food.
Some ants can carry objects heavier than their own body weight.

safetyNotes.en: Some ants bite or sting. Watch from a distance and do not touch them.
safetyNotes.id: Beberapa semut menggigit atau menyengat. Amati dari jauh dan jangan disentuh.

safetyNotes.en: Bread contains wheat: if your child has a wheat or gluten allergy, use a crumb of fruit instead. Wash hands after handling food and watching the ants.
safetyNotes.id: Roti mengandung gandum: jika anak alergi gandum atau gluten, gunakan potongan kecil buah. Cuci tangan setelah memegang makanan dan mengamati semut.

en: Beni's front tooth feels funny. When he pushes it with his tongue, it wiggles.
Mum takes a look. 'It is a wobbly baby tooth,' she says. 'It is getting ready to come out.'
Beni feels a little worried. Will it hurt? 'Usually it just feels a bit strange,' says Mum.
At lunch Beni bites into a slice of guava. Crunch! Out pops the tooth. Now there is a gap.
'Look in the mirror,' says Mum. 'A new tooth is already coming under there. It is a grown-up tooth, and it has to last you all your life.'
That night Beni brushes extra carefully, around the gap and all his other teeth.
id: Gigi depan Beni terasa aneh. Saat ia mendorongnya dengan lidah, giginya bergoyang.
Ibu melihatnya. 'Itu gigi susu yang goyang,' katanya. 'Sebentar lagi gigi itu akan tanggal.'
Beni sedikit khawatir. Apakah akan sakit? 'Biasanya hanya terasa agak aneh,' kata Ibu.
Saat makan siang, Beni menggigit sepotong jambu biji. Kres! Giginya copot. Sekarang ada celah.
'Coba lihat di cermin,' kata Ibu. 'Gigi baru sudah mulai tumbuh di situ. Itu gigi dewasa, dan harus kamu jaga seumur hidup.'
Malam itu Beni menyikat gigi dengan sangat hati-hati, di sekitar celah dan semua giginya yang lain.

objectives.en: Reads a short story and explains how the character's feelings change.
objectives.id: Membaca cerita pendek dan menjelaskan bagaimana perasaan tokoh berubah.

objectives.en: Knows that baby teeth are replaced by adult teeth that must last.
objectives.id: Tahu bahwa gigi susu diganti gigi dewasa yang harus dijaga.

meaning.en: moving a little because it is loose
an empty space between two things
meaning.id: ruang kosong di antara dua benda

meaning.en: one of the first teeth a child grows
meaning.id: gigi pertama yang tumbuh pada anak

prompt.en: What was Beni eating when the tooth came out?
prompt.id: Apa yang sedang Beni makan saat giginya copot?

prompt.en: What happened right after the tooth came out?
prompt.id: Apa yang terjadi tepat setelah giginya copot?

en: Mum told Beni to look in the mirror
Beni pushed the tooth with his tongue
Beni felt worried it would hurt

prompt.en: What does 'wobbly' mean in the story?
prompt.id: Apa arti 'goyang' dalam cerita?

prompt.en: Why did Beni brush extra carefully that night?
prompt.id: Mengapa malam itu Beni menyikat gigi dengan sangat hati-hati?

en: he wanted to look after his new tooth that must last
id: ia ingin menjaga gigi barunya yang harus awet

connection.en: Adult teeth are not replaced, so brushing and healthy food matter.
connection.id: Gigi dewasa tidak akan diganti lagi, jadi menyikat gigi dan makanan sehat itu penting.

connection.en: Children's baby teeth fall out and adult teeth grow in their place.
connection.id: Gigi susu anak tanggal dan gigi dewasa tumbuh menggantikannya.

discussionPrompts.en: How did Beni feel at the start, and at the end?
discussionPrompts.id: Bagaimana perasaan Beni di awal dan di akhir?

en: Lia and Dad are going to the market. They need fruit for a picnic with Lia's two cousins.
Lia writes a list. 'One banana for each of us. That is me, Dad, and my two cousins.'
At the market, the fruit seller has a big pile of yellow bananas and green guavas.
Lia counts out the bananas: one, two, three, four. 'Four bananas for four people!'
Dad picks two guavas too. 'We can cut these and share them,' he says.
At the picnic, everyone has a banana and a piece of guava. Lia's list worked!

Di pasar, penjual buah punya setumpuk besar pisang kuning dan jambu biji hijau.

Ayah juga memilih dua jambu biji. 'Kita bisa memotong dan membaginya,' katanya.
Saat piknik, semua orang mendapat satu pisang dan sepotong jambu biji. Daftar Lia berhasil!

en: Animals have different numbers of legs. Let's count them!
A chicken has 2 legs. People have 2 legs too.
A cat has 4 legs. So do goats and buffaloes.
An ant has 6 legs. Every insect has 6 legs.
A spider has 8 legs. That is why a spider is not an insect!
A snake has no legs at all. It slides along on its belly.

Semut punya 6 kaki. Semua serangga punya 6 kaki.

en: It is almost time for Zuhur. Kakek and Fajar go to the tap in the yard.
Fajar turns the tap on all the way. Whoosh! The water splashes everywhere.
Kakek smiles and turns it down. 'A little water is enough, Fajar. Water is a gift. We do not waste it.'
Fajar watches Kakek carefully. Hands, mouth, nose, face. Then arms, head, ears and feet.
Now it is Fajar's turn. He goes slowly, one step at a time, with a thin stream of water.
'Look, Kakek, only a little puddle!' Kakek pats his shoulder. 'Now we are ready to pray.'
id: Hampir waktu Zuhur. Kakek dan Fajar pergi ke keran di halaman.
Fajar membuka keran sampai penuh. Byur! Air memercik ke mana-mana.
Kakek tersenyum dan mengecilkannya. 'Sedikit air sudah cukup, Fajar. Air itu nikmat. Kita tidak menyia-nyiakannya.'
Fajar memperhatikan Kakek dengan saksama. Tangan, mulut, hidung, wajah. Lalu lengan, kepala, telinga, dan kaki.
Sekarang giliran Fajar. Ia berwudu pelan-pelan, satu langkah demi satu langkah, dengan aliran air yang kecil.
'Lihat, Kek, genangannya sedikit saja!' Kakek menepuk bahunya. 'Sekarang kita siap salat.'

en: In the morning, Arif stands in the yard. His shadow is long and thin. It stretches far across the grass.
At lunchtime, the sun is high above his head. Arif looks down. His shadow is short and small, right by his feet.
In the afternoon, Arif goes out again. His shadow is long again, but now it points the other way!
'Why does my shadow change?' asks Arif. Grandma smiles. 'Watch where the sun is each time.'
Arif sees it. When the sun is low, the shadow is long. When the sun is high, the shadow is short.
Arif draws round his shadow with chalk three times in one day. He has made a shadow clock!
id: Pagi hari, Arif berdiri di halaman. Bayangannya panjang dan ramping, terbentang jauh di atas rumput.
Saat makan siang, matahari tinggi di atas kepalanya. Arif melihat ke bawah. Bayangannya pendek dan kecil, tepat di dekat kakinya.
Sore hari, Arif keluar lagi. Bayangannya panjang lagi, tetapi sekarang menunjuk ke arah sebaliknya!
'Kenapa bayanganku berubah?' tanya Arif. Nenek tersenyum. 'Perhatikan di mana matahari setiap kali.'
Arif mengerti. Saat matahari rendah, bayangan panjang. Saat matahari tinggi, bayangan pendek.
Arif menggambar garis bayangannya dengan kapur tiga kali dalam sehari. Ia sudah membuat jam bayangan!

title.en: The night the lights went out

en: Click! Suddenly the whole house went dark. Even the fan stopped turning.
Sari held Mama's hand. 'I can't see anything!' Mama said softly, 'Let's wait a moment. Our eyes will get used to the dark.'
Slowly Sari began to see shapes: the table, the window, Mama's smile.
Papa found the torch in the drawer where it always lives. Click! A circle of light shone on the floor.
With no TV and no fan, the house was quiet. Sari could hear crickets and frogs outside.
They sat together on the step and sang songs. Then, click! The lights came back on. Sari was almost sorry.
id: Klik! Tiba-tiba seluruh rumah gelap. Kipas angin pun berhenti berputar.
Sari memegang tangan Mama. 'Aku tidak bisa melihat apa-apa!' Mama berkata pelan, 'Kita tunggu sebentar. Mata kita akan terbiasa dengan gelap.'
Pelan-pelan Sari mulai melihat bentuk-bentuk: meja, jendela, senyum Mama.
Papa menemukan senter di laci, tempat senter selalu disimpan. Klik! Lingkaran cahaya menyinari lantai.
Tanpa TV dan kipas angin, rumah jadi sunyi. Sari bisa mendengar jangkrik dan katak di luar.
Mereka duduk bersama di tangga dan bernyanyi. Lalu, klik! Lampu menyala lagi. Sari malah sedikit kecewa.
